facts.text: Advanced manufacturers including Tempo Flexible Packaging and Roadwarrior have chosen Innisfil as their home base.

facts.text: The Town is leading a collaboration to turn an 83-acre parcel into the Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre (RVH) Innisfil Campus.
facts.evidence: The Town is also leading a collaboration to transform an 83-acre parcel of land into the Royal Victoria Regional Health Centre (RVH) Innisfil Campus.

facts.text: When completed, the Friday Harbour resort is expected to create 1,000 permanent jobs on the resort and 1,500 jobs offsite.
facts.evidence: when completed, the Friday Harbour resort will generate approximately $4.4 million and $2.4 million annually in taxes for Innisfil and Simcoe County, respectively, in addition to creating 1,000 permanent jobs on the resort and 1,500 jobs offsite.

meta.descriptor: a fast-growing town on the western shore of Lake Simcoe, south of Barrie
meta.fact: home to more than 4,000 businesses and the Friday Harbour resort on Lake Simcoe

overview: Innisfil grew 18.5% between 2016 and 2021, from 36,566 to 43,326 residents, with 15,708 occupied private dwellings across 262.39 square kilometres. The median age is 42.0. Growth this fast means a large share of households are new and still looking for trusted local providers.

The population is spread between Alcona, smaller lakeshore communities and rural villages, so a business rarely reaches the whole town from one spot. Being easy to find online matters more here than in a compact city.

byService.lead-generation: After 18.5% growth since 2016, Innisfil lead generation should target new homeowners in fresh subdivisions, where demand for trades, home services and family services is concentrated.
byService.seo: Innisfil residents often search by community name, so SEO should build pages for Alcona, Cookstown, Lefroy and Stroud instead of relying on the town name alone.
byService.website-development: Across 262.39 square kilometres of lakeshore and farmland, a website should state service areas plainly and make booking simple for customers who will not drive in to ask.
byService.branding: Branding in Innisfil works best when it feels local to Lake Simcoe and its communities, showing that a growing business still knows its neighbours.
